title: A Sermon on the Estate of Marriage Revised and Corrected by Dr. Martin Luther, Augustinian at Wittenberg, 1519 (Marjorie Elizabeth Plummer)
notes: The book's heading prints no text; its introduction names the one it was preached on (John 2:1–11, the wedding at Cana, the second Sunday after Epiphany 1519), which is the row's passage. The ref is read from the label "John 2:1–11"; the archive's index has no Logos reference for it.
